summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs (itself obfuscated with `_0xXXXX` identifiers) downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unzips it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and runs it via execFileSync against a sibling `math_init.js` file. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated blob (string-array rotator, control-flow obfuscation, numeric constant tables) whose behavior is not inspectable in the tarball. The declared package purpose is a trivial `Hello ${name}!` TypeScript sample, which provides no legitimate reason to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime specifically to execute an opaque bundled payload. This fires automatically on `npm install`, so any installer of this package runs the obfuscated payload under a runtime that bypasses Node-focused scanners. The alternate-runtime + obfuscated-payload pattern is the canonical dropper shape for install-time code execution on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
